reports.title: Turkish Statistical Institute (TurkStat) institutional core
reports.description: Primary national statistical office responsible for censuses, surveys, national accounts, prices, labour, demographic and multi-domain socio-economic statistics.
reports._notes: Foundational institutional node for the Turkish statistical system.
reports._cadence_evidence: tuik.gov.tr homepage is a rolling release portal: it lists many separate dated bulletins (Motor Vehicles July 2026, Wage Earner Statistics June 2026, Service and Construction Production Indices June 2026, Agricultural PPI July 2026, Property Sales July 2026) and links a 'Veri Yayımlama Takvimi' publication calendar. The institution as a whole has no single discrete release cadence.
reports.cadence_note: Continuously updated database/portal with no discrete editions. The number is the renderer convention decided 2026-08-18 (HANDOFF section 7) and applied 2026-08-19: a nominal releases_per_year so that absence keeps meaning 'one-off instrument' only - 250 encodes business-day updating (the live corpus's daily-FX convention), 365 genuinely all-days monitoring. It is a statement of continuous flow for the pulse/beam system, not a claim of counted editions - the observed reality is in _cadence_evidence.

reports.title: Population census and estimates
reports.description: Official population census and Address-Based Population Registration System estimates. Population is approximately 88 million; urbanisation is high and the age structure is still relatively young compared with Europe.
reports._cadence_evidence: URL is the TurkStat homepage, which shows no population (Adrese Dayalı Nüfus Kayıt Sistemi) release and states no census/estimate periodicity. The linked release calendar (tuik.gov.tr/Kurumsal/Veri_Takvimi and its veriportali redirect) renders only via JavaScript and returned no entries, so no countable evidence.

reports.title: National Accounts of Turkey (GDP)
reports.description: Official national accounts (GDP by industry and expenditure). Central macro-output series for a large, diversified upper-middle-income economy with significant manufacturing and services.
reports._cadence_evidence: URL is the TurkStat homepage; no GDP (Gayri Safi Yurt İçi Hasıla) release appears among the listed bulletins and no periodicity is stated. The linked data release calendar was JavaScript-only and returned no entries.

reports.title: Consumer Price Index and inflation statistics
reports.description: Monthly CPI and inflation rates. Turkey has experienced elevated and volatile inflation in recent years; the CPI series is a critical high-frequency price and policy signal.
reports._notes: Core high-frequency price node. Elevated-inflation environment gives this series high centrality.

reports.title: Balance of Payments and external accounts
reports.publisher: Central Bank of the Republic of Türkiye
reports.description: BOP and external-sector statistics. Structural current-account dynamics, strong tourism and services credits, and capital-account volatility are recurring features.
reports._notes: External-accounts node with important services/tourism contribution.
reports._cadence_evidence: On tcmb.gov.tr the balance of payments appears only as a category heading, 'Ödemeler Dengesi ve İlgili İstatistikler', with no frequency label and no dated editions listed (a neighbouring item, International Reserves and FX Liquidity, is month-tagged, but that is a different series).

reports.title: Labour force and unemployment statistics
reports.description: Official labour-force participation, employment and unemployment rates (including seasonally adjusted series). Recent unemployment has fallen to multi-year lows in the mid-to-high single digits; youth and female rates remain structurally higher.
reports._notes: Primary labour-market statistical product. High-frequency series.

reports.title: Industrial production and manufacturing statistics
reports.description: Monthly industrial production index and manufacturing output. Manufacturing dominates industrial activity (food, basic metals, motor vehicles, textiles, chemicals, electrical equipment, apparel, etc.). Closely watched as a high-frequency activity indicator.

reports.title: Tourism arrivals and tourism revenue statistics
reports.description: Official statistics on international visitor arrivals and tourism receipts. Tourism is a major services credit in the balance of payments; recent years show arrivals in the 60+ million range and revenues above USD 60 billion.

reports.title: Türkiye–EU merchandise trade statistics
reports.description: Bilateral goods trade with the European Union under the Customs Union. Motor vehicles, machinery, electrical equipment and related manufactures dominate both directions. Bilateral trade volume has exceeded €200 billion in recent years.
reports._notes: Quantitative densification of the EU trade corridor.
reports._url_evidence: European Commission DG TRADE Türkiye page states bilateral goods trade reached a record €217.6bn in 2025 (EU exports €114.3bn, imports €103.3bn) with motor vehicles/machinery dominant - the official EU bilateral trade product page.
reports._cadence_evidence: The Commission's DG TRADE Türkiye country page carries continuously maintained trade figures (2025 goods data) with only a data-timing note, 'Services data is only available with a delay of one year'; no edition, issue number or release schedule.

reports.title: Central government budget revenue and expenditure statistics
reports.description: Official central government budget realization covering revenues, expenditures, primary balance and overall budget balance. Key fiscal-flow series monitored against Medium-Term Programme targets.
reports._url_evidence: Ministry of Treasury and Finance 'Merkezi Yönetim Bütçe Gerçekleşme Raporu' (May 2026) reporting bütçe giderleri, bütçe gelirleri and bütçe dengesi; the HTML landing pages on hmb.gov.tr/muhasebat.hmb.gov.tr are JavaScript-only, so the report file itself was used.
reports._cadence_evidence: The PDF is the 'Mayıs Ayı Merkezi Yönetim Bütçe Gerçekleşme Raporu' (May 2026) and states that the Central Government Monthly Budget Realization Report 'her ay yayımlanır' - is published every month.

reports.title: Public debt and debt management statistics
reports.description: Official statistics on central government and public-sector debt stocks, domestic and external composition, and debt-service indicators. Continuously referenced in fiscal sustainability and external vulnerability analysis.
reports._url_evidence: Ministry of Treasury and Finance 'Kamu Borç Yönetimi Raporu' No. 246 (January 2026) with total debt stock 13.656 trillion TL, domestic 59.7% / external 40.3%, debt service and maturity tables.
reports._cadence_evidence: Cover reads 'Kamu Borç Yönetimi Raporu No: 246, Ocak 2026' and the report carries monthly data tables. The sequential issue number (246 by January 2026, series running since roughly mid-2005) is consistent only with one issue per month; no explicit periodicity sentence appears in the document.

reports.title: CBRT monetary policy and policy-rate statistics
reports.publisher: Central Bank of the Republic of Türkiye
reports.description: Policy interest rate decisions and related monetary-policy indicators. Policy rates have been held at elevated levels in recent periods as part of the disinflation effort under high inflation.
reports._notes: Core monetary-policy instrument node under elevated inflation.
reports._cadence_evidence: tcmb.gov.tr lists dated MPC interest-rate press releases for 2026 - 12 March, 22 April, 11 June, 23 July - i.e. four decisions in about four and a half months, roughly six-week intervals, giving eight scheduled rate decisions per year. (The Inflation Report on the same page is quarterly: 2026-I 13 Feb, 2026-II 14 May, 2026-III 13 Aug.)

reports.title: Banking system structure and credit statistics
reports.publisher: CBRT / Banking Regulation and Supervision Agency (BRSA)
reports.description: Statistics on the structure of the banking system, total assets, credit aggregates and related indicators. Credit conditions interact tightly with monetary policy and inflation.
reports._url_evidence: CBRT 'Parasal ve Finansal İstatistikler' series page listing weekly and monthly money and banking statistics, non-bank financial institutions, securities and financial accounts - the official banking/credit aggregates series (BRSA's bddk.org.tr is unreachable via WebFetch).
reports._cadence_evidence: The CBRT Monetary and Financial Statistics page labels its series by frequency: 'Haftalık Para ve Banka İstatistikleri' (weekly) alongside 'Aylık Para ve Banka İstatistikleri' (monthly) and weekly flow interest/profit rate statistics. Weekly is the highest stated cadence for the banking/credit aggregates, so 52 per year, with the monthly compilation nested inside it.

reports.title: Non-performing loans and banking asset-quality statistics
reports.description: System-wide and segment-level non-performing loan ratios and volumes. NPL ratios have risen from low levels under the tight monetary stance and high inflation environment.
reports._notes: Core asset-quality / risk node for the banking cluster.
reports._url_evidence: CBRT Financial Stability Report series page (semi-annual, latest May 2026 issue 42) covering banking sector asset quality including non-performing loan trends; BRSA (bddk.org.tr) is domain unreachable via WebFetch.
reports._cadence_evidence: CBRT Financial Stability Report page lists numbered editions on a strict May/November pattern - May 2026 (No. 42), November 2025 (No. 41), May 2025 (No. 40), November 2024 (No. 39) - back to 2005: two issues per year.

reports.title: Istanbul Gross Regional Domestic Product
reports.description: Official GRDP for Istanbul — by far the largest provincial economy, accounting for roughly 29% of national GDP in recent estimates. Dominant services, finance, trade and industrial concentration; global-city node.
reports._notes: Primary economic-core regional node. Highest single provincial share.

reports.title: Ankara Gross Regional Domestic Product
reports.description: Official GRDP for Ankara — the capital and second-largest provincial economy (around 10–11% of national GDP). Strong public administration, services and industrial presence.
reports._url_evidence: Retrieved and read. TurkStat PDF 'Main Revisions Studies on Gross Domestic Product by Provinces - Explanatory Note', published by TurkStat's Directorate of National Accounts Department, Presidency of Regional Accounts Group, dated 11 December 2025. It is the official TurkStat document for the Il Bazinda Gayrisafi Yurt Ici Hasila series: it sets out data sources and calculation methods for provincial GDP at current prices and chain-linked volume indices, the 2025 main revision, ESA-2010 alignment, and states the regional GDP series have been extended back to 2000 across all 81 provinces (Annex 1 gives the full IBBS/NUTS classification). CAVEAT, stated plainly: this is the series-level methodology/revision note, not a table of Ankara's GRDP figures. The province-level data pages and the dated bulletin 'Il Bazinda Gayrisafi Yurt Ici Hasila, 2024' (id 53930) sit only on veriportali.tuik.gov.tr, which serves the JavaScript-required stub on every path, so no Ankara-specific page could be confirmed. A Turkish-language twin of this document was also verified at .../A%C3%A7%C4%B1klama_dok%C3%BCman%C4%B1_BHG_TR2025.pdf.
reports._url_route: static PDF under /indir/ on www.tuik.gov.tr - TurkStat's institutional site renders server-side and hosts real files, unlike the data portal; found via search, then fetched and read

reports.title: Izmir Gross Regional Domestic Product
reports.description: Official GRDP for Izmir — the third-largest provincial economy and principal Aegean industrial, port and services hub.
_referenced_by: Provincial ranking and Aegean regional analysis
reports._url_evidence: Same retrieved-and-read TurkStat document as above: 'Main Revisions Studies on Gross Domestic Product by Provinces - Explanatory Note' (TurkStat, National Accounts Department / Regional Accounts Group, 11 December 2025), the official methodology and revision document for the provincial GDP (Il Bazinda GSYH) series covering all 81 provinces back to 2000. CAVEAT: series-level methodology note, not Izmir's GRDP figures; the province data pages are only on veriportali.tuik.gov.tr, which is a JavaScript-only SPA on every path.

reports.title: Agriculture and crop production statistics
reports.description: Official volume statistics for cereals, vegetables, fruits and other crops. Wheat, barley, maize, tomatoes, fruits and related products form the core of agricultural output; production is sensitive to climate variability.
reports._cadence_evidence: URL is the TurkStat homepage; no crop production (Bitkisel Üretim) release is among the listed bulletins and no periodicity is stated. The linked release calendar could not be read (JavaScript-only page).

reports.title: Electricity generation and installed capacity statistics
reports.publisher: Ministry of Energy and Natural Resources
reports.description: Installed generation capacity and electricity production by source (coal, natural gas, hydro, wind, solar, geothermal, etc.). Capacity exceeds 120 GW; the mix is diversifying with strong growth in renewables.
reports._url_evidence: Ministry of Energy and Natural Resources electricity information page: installed capacity 126,113 MW as of June 2026 with shares by source, and 2025 generation of 362.9 TWh broken down by coal, gas, hydro, wind, solar, geothermal.
reports._cadence_evidence: enerji.gov.tr electricity information page carries only 'Güncelleme Tarihi: 20 Temmuz 2026' (update date) with no stated update frequency and no list of dated editions.

reports.title: Education enrolment, literacy and attainment statistics
reports.description: Official statistics on literacy, mean years of schooling, and tertiary attainment. Literacy is high (~98%); tertiary attainment among younger cohorts has risen sharply (25–34 age group ~45% in recent data).
reports._notes: Core education and human-capital stock node.
reports._cadence_evidence: URL is the TurkStat homepage; no education statistics release appears in the listed bulletins and no periodicity is stated. The linked data release calendar was not retrievable (JavaScript-only).

reports.title: Life expectancy and vital statistics
reports.description: Official life tables and life expectancy at birth. Recent estimates place life expectancy at birth around 78.1 years (2022–2024 period), with females living substantially longer than males.
reports._cadence_evidence: URL is the TurkStat homepage; no life tables (Hayat Tabloları) or vital statistics release appears among the listed bulletins and no periodicity is stated. The linked release calendar was JavaScript-only and returned no entries, so the life-table cadence could not be verified from the page.

reports.title: Poverty and living conditions statistics
reports.description: Official relative poverty rates and living-conditions indicators from household surveys. Relative poverty rate has been reported in the low-to-mid teens in recent releases; absolute poverty has declined substantially over the longer term while regional disparities persist.
reports._notes: Core welfare measurement node. Interacts tightly with inflation and regional disparity.

reports.title: E-commerce volume and digital trade statistics
reports.description: Official statistics on e-commerce volume and transaction counts. In 2025 general e-commerce volume exceeded 4.57 trillion TL (roughly USD 115 billion), with strong multi-year growth; retail e-commerce forms a large share. E-commerce accounted for an estimated ~6.9% of GDP in 2025.
reports._notes: Core digital-commerce statistical product. High-growth series under elevated inflation and digitalisation.
reports._url_evidence: Retrieved and read the PDF itself: 'Turkiye'de E-Ticaretin Gorunumu Raporu 2025', published by the Ministry of Trade (Ticaret Bakanligi), Directorate General of Domestic Trade, E-Commerce Department, May 2026, covering 2025 data. Figures match the node description exactly: general e-commerce volume 4.57 trillion TL (+52.2%), retail e-commerce 2.46 trillion TL (+51.8%), USD 115.43 billion, 6.9% of GDP, 19.3% of total commerce, 5.94 billion transactions, 634,611 businesses. The Ministry's own announcement page https://ticaret.gov.tr/duyurular/turkiyede-e-ticaretin-gorunumu-raporu-yayinlandi-12-05-2026 was also fetched and links to this exact PDF.
reports._url_route: parent ministry main site instead of the dead subdomain - eticaret.gov.tr is unreachable, but ticaret.gov.tr renders and serves the report from its static /data/ path

reports.title: Greenhouse gas inventory statistics
reports.publisher: Ministry of Environment, Urbanisation and Climate Change / UNFCCC submissions
reports.description: Official national GHG inventory (National Inventory Document). Recent estimates place total emissions in the low-to-mid 500 MtCO2e range; energy is the dominant source sector.
reports._url_evidence: UNFCCC document record 'Türkiye. 2025 National Inventory Document (NID)', submitted 15 April 2025 and listed under 2025 Annex I national greenhouse gas inventory submissions.
reports._cadence_evidence: UNFCCC document page shows 'Türkiye. 2025 National Inventory Document (NID)', submitted 15 April 2025, filed under the annual national GHG inventory submission cycle - one inventory submission per year.

reports.title: Nationally Determined Contribution (NDC) climate framing
reports.description: Türkiye’s Nationally Determined Contribution under the Paris Agreement, setting quantified GHG reduction targets relative to a business-as-usual baseline. Continuously cited in climate policy, energy transition and international negotiations.
reports._url_evidence: Türkiye's Second NDC (NDC 3.0) as filed in the UNFCCC NDC Registry (submitted 9 November 2025): 466 Mt CO2e reduction vs BAU, emissions capped at 643 Mt CO2e by 2035, net zero by 2053.
reports._cadence_evidence: 'The Second NDC of Türkiye' (2025) is a single dated submission under the Paris Agreement; it identifies itself as successor to the Updated First NDC and references the first Global Stocktake, but states no submission cycle, so it is treated as a one-off policy document rather than a five-yearly series.
